title: milium holciforme var. sphacelatum
intro: Milium holciforme var. sphacelatum, commonly known as Wild Garlic, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is prized for its culinary and medicinal uses, offering a range of health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Garlic include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Wild Garlic include alkaloids, such as galantamine, which have been shown to possess neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties.
